recognize_zh: 抹片上布滿大小一致的小型成熟淋巴球，核圓深染、染色質粗塊狀、胞質只有一圈細邊，數量遠多於其他白血球，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）的淋巴球增多。
features: Marked increase in small, uniform mature lymphocytes
Round nuclei with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin
Very scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
No nucleoli evident; occasional slightly larger cells
No other leukocyte lineages seen in this field
describe_en: Smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small, uniform mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, dense clumped chromatin and a very scant rim of cytoplasm, set in a red cell background. Nucleoli are not conspicuous and large transformed cells are not increased. Smudge cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population of at least 5 x 10^9/L is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma shows more pleomorphic, notched nuclei and is CD23-negative, cyclin D1-positive.
Reactive lymphocytosis is polyclonal and transient, with more variable cell size and cytoplasm, and pertussis lymphocytes often have cleaved nuclei in children.
Circulating follicular lymphoma cells are small with deeply cleft (buttock) nuclei and are CD10-positive, CD5-negative.
MBL has an identical CLL phenotype but a clonal B-cell count below 5 x 10^9/L without tissue involvement, which morphology alone cannot distinguish.
